### 1. Precise definitions

System model:
- N workers W_1..W_N, each stateless: persistent state limited to (a) private signing key sk_i, (b) nothing else. All working state derivable from network input.
- Adversary: up to f Byzantine workers (crash, equivocate, send garbage), f < N/3. Network: eventually-delivery gossip, authenticated channels (signatures), no global clock.
- Determinism contract Φ: a pure function spec such that for any task t and any honest worker i executing pinned binary B: out_i(t) = out_j(t) byte-for-byte. Violations detectable.

Definitions:
- **Voice** V = (D_0, D_1, ...) infinite sequence of decisions. Decision D_r ∈ 𝒟 finite domain.
- **Honest univocality (one voice)**: For all honest i,j and all r: after gossip stabilizes, i's reconstructed prefix equals j's: V^i_{0..r} = V^j_{0..r}, byte-identical.
- **No drift**: ∀ t, ∀ honest i,j: out_i(t) = out_j(t) (byte equality of canonical encoding).
- **No central brain**: no worker has a distinguished role in any round beyond what a publicly verifiable, uniformly random, seedless-to-any-single-party process (VRF sortition) assigns; every message's validity is checkable by any party; progress requires no single node liveness (any 2f+1 suffice).
- **Finality**: D_r is final iff ∃ set S, |S| ≥ 2f+1, s.t. every member of S signed (D_r, r) — i.e., certificate C_r. Quorum intersection ⇒ any two certificates for different D at same r overlap in ≥ f+1 honest ⇒ impossible unless identical D (unforgeability of signatures). Hence at most one D_r can ever be final. Safety.
- **Liveness**: with eventual delivery and honest majority, every round eventually certifies.

Frontier-scout burn semantics (domain):
- Search frontier F = set of open nodes. Each round, workers "burn" compute scouting assigned frontier nodes, producing scores/expansions. Decisions decide: accept/reject expansions, update frontier, allocate next burns.

### 2. Schema

Canonical encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers big-endian where multi-byte, maps with lexicographically sorted keys, no floats anywhere — scores are rational pairs (num:int64, den:uint64>0) reduced, or fixed-point int128 scaled by 10^18. Hash: SHA-256. Signatures: Ed25519 over H(domain_sep || canonical_bytes).

Objects (all content-addressed, id = hex(H(canonical_bytes))):

```
DomainSep = "FSCB/v1"

Task {
  task_id:    bstr[32]        // H(DomainSep||"task"||round||index||frontier_node_id)
  round:      uint64
  node_id:    bstr[32]        // frontier node being scouted
  op:         enum {SCOUT_EXPAND, SCOUT_SCORE, VERIFY}
  params:     bstr            // canonical, includes seed = H(task_id)
  budget:     uint64          // burn units (compute steps)
}

Result {
  result_id:  bstr[32]        // H(canonical(self))
  task_id:    bstr[32]
  worker_id:  bstr[32]        // public key
  findings:   bstr            // canonical payload: children node specs, score rationals
  burn_used:  uint64
  exec_meta:  ExecMeta        // toolchain hash, code hash — must equal pinned values
}

ExecMeta {
  binary_hash: bstr[32]
  vm_version:  uint32
}

Vote {                       // attestation on a Result
  result_id: bstr[32]
  voter_id:  bstr[32]
  verdict:   enum {ACCEPT, REJECT}   // REJECT only with reason code (drift/malformed)
  sig:       bstr[64]
}

Proposal {                   // per-round candidate decision (any worker may emit)
  round:       uint64
  prev_final:  bstr[32]      // H(Decision_{r-1})
  results:     [bstr[32]]    // sorted unique result_ids included
  frontier_delta: bstr        // canonical patch derived deterministically from results
  sig:         bstr[64]
}

Decision {                   // finalized
  round:       uint64
  proposal_id: bstr[32]
  cert:        [CertEntry]   // ≥2f+1 entries
}
CertEntry { signer: bstr[32], sig: bstr[64] }   // sig over H(DomainSep||"cert"||proposal_id)
```

Frontier state:
```
FrontierNode {
  node_id:   bstr[32]   // H(parent_id || child_index || child_canonical_payload)
  parent_id: bstr[32] | null
  payload:   bstr
  depth:     uint64
  status:    enum {OPEN, SCOUTED, CLOSED}
  best_score: Rational | null
}
Rational { num: int64, den: uint64 }  // den > 0, gcd(num,den)=1, canonical sign on num
```

Global state S_r = (frontier map, ledger of burns per worker, last finalized decision hash). S_r is itself content-addressed: S_id = H(canonical(S_r)). Statelessness: worker recomputes S_r by replaying decisions D_0..D_{r-1} through Apply (pure).

### 3. Exact algorithm

Constants: N, f = ⌊(N−1)/3⌋, Q = 2f+1, Δ_gossip (retry bound), BURN_CAP per task.

**Phase A — Bootstrapping round r (every worker, independently):**

A1. Reconstruct state: fetch finalized chain up to highest r' with valid certificate reachable in local view; replay Apply to get S_{r'}.
A2. Derive assignment without a brain: each worker computes the task set for round r'+1:
   - Open nodes O = {n ∈ frontier : status=OPEN}, sorted by node_id.
   - Sortition: for slot k in 0..|O|−1: assignee = W_{ π(k) } where π(k) = H(DomainSep||"sort"||prev_final||k) mod N. Everyone derives identical assignment table T.
   - Worker i's own tasks: my_tasks = {t_k : π(k)=i}. (Deterministic; no negotiation.)
A3. Execute each task under determinism contract:
   - Seed RNG: rng = ChaCha20(seed=H(task_id)).
   - All iteration over sets/maps in sorted-key order; arithmetic in int128/fixed-point; no syscalls for time/random/env; burn meter counts VM steps, abort at budget with partial result flagged `TRUNCATED`.
   - Emit Result, sign, gossip.

If y ≠ x (byte compare): emit Vote{result_id=x.id, verdict=REJECT, reason=DRIFT} and Vote{result_id=y.id, verdict=ACCEPT}? - Rounds are logical: worker advances its round when its view contains ≥ 2f+1 vertices from current round (this is local, asynchronous, no timeouts needed for safety; liveness under eventual delivery).
- Vertex V_i,r = {author=i, round=r, parents=[own r−1 vertex] ∪ [strongly-seen set], payload}.

Since commit property is monotone and stable, all honest workers converge to identical L prefix. One voice. ✔
